newsitem.title: USA: AGP & Co plans to sell TMC Group unit.
newsitem.headline: AGP & Co plans to sell TMC Group unit.

text.p: AGP & Co said it agreed to sell its TMC Group Inc unit to Social Expressions Acquisition Corp and Joseph Drucker, a director and general counsel of AGP, for $2.5 million in Social Expressions stock, $6 million of TMC Group secured debt and a three-year royalty of 0.75 percent of TMC's annual revenue.

Social Expressions is owned by Omar Perraza, who controls about 12 percent of AGP's common stock, AGP said, which added that the sale is pending the approval of its shareholders. The shareholders will vote on the sale on or about January 15, said AGP, whose officials were not available to comment.
TMC Group makes wedding accessories and children's gifts.
